'''Hydian Exploration''' was a mining company that, along with [[InterGalactic Ore]], [[Vulca Minerals]], and others, operated on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GatORW" />
